• Elvenkind - May be any one of fire, air, earth, water, light, dark, drowe, winter, twilight or wood elves. 
• Faeries may not be pacted, nor may Seasonal, Onyx or Jade Elves

ability.acute-hearing.Name: Acute Hearing
ability.acute-hearing.Effect: Allows the user to hear the movements of any creature within 60’. Effectively this means that when the character uses the ability by declaring ‘Acute Hearing’ all creatures within hearing should indicate their broad race category (e.g. elven) and location. At ref’s discretion some creatures may not make sounds, and things walking within walls are generally silent as the walls muffle their noises.

ability.perfect-human-disguise.Name: Perfect Human disguise
ability.perfect-human-disguise.Effect: May assume a human like appearance as a disguise which may not be penetrated by either physical or mystical means. Once this form is assumed (and the choice to do so must be done at the beginning of the adventure) they look and smell human in all ways, and no method will disprove this concealment. This mystical protection also extends to their choice of name for the adventure, their alignment and their profession. e.g. Hillis the Altunhust Horstval Druid of neutral good alignment takes a human form at the beginning of the adventure. To all means of detection he chooses to be Trewin, the Human Warrior and to appear to be Lawful Neutral in alignment. All spells, miracles and other powers as well as physical training will indicate this is the case. At the start of another adventure he could be completely different.

ability.lvl-2-spell.Name: Lvl 2 Spell
ability.lvl-2-spell.Effect: From third level, they can cast any one standard 2nd level spell once per two levels. At sixth level they may cast a standard 3rd level spell once per 2 levels. These spells cannot be of the same colour, nor may they be of opposite colours.

ability.lvl-3-spell.Name: Lvl 3 Spell
ability.lvl-3-spell.Effect: From third level, they can cast any one standard 2nd level spell once per two levels. At sixth level they may cast a standard 3rd level spell once per 2 levels. These spells cannot be of the same colour, nor may they be of opposite colours.

ability.detect-lie-atwill.Name: Detect Lie (At Will)
ability.detect-lie-atwill.Effect: For the next 5 minutes, the user is aware whether any statements he hears the target make are lies.

ability.dac.Name: DAC
ability.dac.Effect: Grants Dexterity Armour Class equal to the Count value.

ability.mac.Name: MAC
ability.mac.Effect: Grants Magical Armour Class equal to the Count value.

ability.defend-the-master.Name: Defend the Master
ability.defend-the-master.Effect: Negates one listed magical stopping effect and grants immunity to that effect for the following five minutes x 1/day. There must be another member of the Circle on the adventure for this to work.

ability.evil-stairway.Name: Evil stairway
ability.evil-stairway.Effect:
This skill allows the Unholy Champion to create a list of evil spiritual innates for his own use.
It will typically follow the ethos of the evil church to which he is aligned, thus an Unholy Champion aligned to a church that likes to raise Undead will have a list which facilitates that, whereas if in a church with a large amount of evil spiritual causing on its miracle list, the Unholy Champion will need to have a predominantly ‘causing’ based list.
1. The total number of innates cannot exceed 40 spirits. It is the spirit cost used, rather than miracle level.
2. It is not possible to have a list with a greater number of higher level innates than lower level ones.
3. It should build up like a pyramid.
4. It is not possible to have a list which contains a particular innate if you do not have at least one innate of each miracle which precedes it on that list (i.e. you can’t have an innate cause serious unless your stairway includes at least one innate Cause Wound).
5. The innates should build up/follow a miracle tree [see Words from Above for further details].
6. It is not possible to have a miracle of a higher level than the level it is gained at when constructing the Stairway.
7. It is possible to have miracles that are traditionally neutral, as long as their purpose is for evil – much like the use of neutral miracles by pathed characters. Thus it would be possible to have ‘protection from goodly spirits’ on the list if used to summon a Wraith.
8. It is only possible to have miracles on the list that are on the miracle list of the Church to which the Champion is aligned.
9. Unaligned Champions do not have to follow rule 8 – they may instead have any standard evil miracle on their list.
10. Aligned Champions may have advanced miracles on their list if they are on the Church’s miracle list, however advanced miracles count as twice their normal spirit level to have on the UC’s list. EG.: Soul’s Hunger would cost 1 spirit x 2 = 2 against the 40 spirit total. Again it is necessary for this religious miracle to make sense to the rest of your list.
11. It is not possible to have miracles running at 1/3 levels.

ability.neutral-stairway-list.Name: Neutral stairway list
ability.neutral-stairway-list.Effect:
This skill allows the Grey Knight to create a list of neutral spiritual innates for his own use.
It will typically follow the ethos of the neutral church to which he is aligned, thus a Grey Knight aligned to a church that focuses on balance or mediation may have a list which facilitates that, whereas if in a church with a large amount of neutral spiritual effects on its miracle list, the Grey Knight will need to have a predominantly utility or balance-based list.
1. The total number of innates cannot exceed 40 spirits. It is the spirit cost used, rather than miracle level.
2. It is not possible to have a list with a greater number of higher level innates than lower level ones.
3. It should build up like a pyramid.
4. It is not possible to have a list which contains a particular innate if you do not have at least one innate of each miracle which precedes it on that list (i.e. you can’t have an innate Cause Serious unless your stairway includes at least one innate Cause Wound).
5. The innates should build up/follow a miracle tree [see Words from Above for further details].
6. It is not possible to have a miracle of a higher level than the level it is gained at when constructing the Stairway.
7. It is possible to have miracles that are traditionally neutral, as long as their purpose fits the ethos of neutrality – much like the use of neutral miracles by pathed characters.
8. It is only possible to have miracles on the list that are on the miracle list of the Church to which the Grey Knight is aligned.
9. Grey Knights do not have to follow rule 8 – they may instead have any standard neutral miracle on their list.
10. Grey Knights may have advanced miracles on their list if they are on the Church’s miracle list, however advanced miracles count as twice their normal spirit level to have on the Grey Knight’s list. EG.: a miracle that normally costs 1 spirit would cost 2 against the 40 spirit total. Again it is necessary for this religious miracle to make sense with the rest of your list.
11. It is not possible to have miracles running at 1/3 levels.

ability.precognition.Name: Precognition
ability.precognition.Effect:
Allows the user to seek confirmation of three facts, gaining Yes / No answers to three separate questions. Questions asked about things which are specifically immune to neuronics (as opposed to merely being mindless) cannot be confirmed, and things with no physical or neuronic aspect to them (such as purely spiritual creatures) will only have questions answered if a creature with a mind knows the answers. 
It takes 30 seconds of uninterrupted concentration to activate, during which time user must sit quietly and take no action. The questions are considered to be asked and answered instantly at the end of the concentration period.

ability.probe.Name: Probe
ability.probe.Effect: The user may ask one question of the target’s mind. The creature is not aware that they are being probed, and the question will be answered truthfully. Only simple answers can be gained from this ability – single facts, for example e.g. “Under the cloth”, “Black”, “I did it”. Before an answer is obtained the user must concentrate in sight of the target for a full 30 seconds.

ability.psychic-cage.Name: Psychic Cage
ability.psychic-cage.Effect: One target within sight is prevented from transporting themselves using mental powers. Each time the target attempts to use such a power (e.g. Neuro-Synaptic Jump, Neuro-Planar Vortex) the user takes 12 tblp (reduced as normal by neural foci) but the target’s ability does not function – effectively the target is instantly returned to the spot which they are attempting to leave. This ability may be released early by the user, and only functions while the target is in sight of the user – in other words, it will not prevent a shift being used if the user cannot see the target.

ability.psychic-guide.Name: Psychic Guide
ability.psychic-guide.Effect: While active, the user is aware of faint traces left on objects and the air itself by the passage of beings with minds, fading with time. This allows the user to track individual minds by following the trail they leave, and also to judge how many minds have been in an area, and how recently. Traces usually fade completely after around 24 hours, though in a heavily used area they may be obscured by newer traces. The traces left behind are unique, so the user may track a specific mind; and if the user has previously seen a mind's aura, such as by the use of Auric Colour, they will recognise it again in the future. It is also possible to distinguish animals and similarly unintelligent minds from those of thinking beings. However, while this ability is active the constant traces left all around make it difficult to focus on the real world - the user may not use dexterity AC during this time.

ability.reactions.Name: Reactions
ability.reactions.Effect: The user gains 3 extra points of DAC for the duration. This ability cannot stack with itself.

ability.read-runes.Name: Read Runes
ability.read-runes.Effect: This skill allows the character to read spiritual runes with the proficiency of a priest. They may fully utilise spiritual scrolls of their alignment with this skill, but not scrolls of any other alignment.

ability.recognise-goodly-spirit.Name: Recognise Goodly Spirit
ability.recognise-goodly-spirit.Effect:
This ability can identify whether the target has a good spirit or not. There is a YES / NO answer.
Range:12 feet
Verbal: Spirit art thou good?

ability.recognise-evil-spirit.Name: Recognise evil spirit
ability.recognise-evil-spirit.Effect:
This ability can identify whether the target has an evil spirit or not. There is a YES / NO answer.
Range:12 feet
Verbal: Spirit art thou evil?

ability.release-own-miracle.Name: Release own miracle
ability.release-own-miracle.Effect:
This ability enables a priest to remove the effects of some of his own miracles from a victim if he so wishes. Whilst the priest points at the person to be freed. The range of this ability is 20’ (roughly 7 paces).
Only certain miracles are affected by this ability – in general these are all miracles with a duration which is not instant, unless the miracle specifically notes in its description that it is not releasable. It should be noted that if a priest dies ALL his releasable miracles are freed, regardless of range!
This does not apply to any scrolls, spirit items etc he may have made. Basically during his death trauma, his involuntary screaming rends the link he has forged between the real and the spiritual planes, and thus his final cry reverberates through /around the spiritual universe!
Verbal: Spirit! I release thee!

ability.repel-evil.Name: Repel Evil
ability.repel-evil.Effect:
This power will work on any Evil creature with a spirit within 20’. An Evil spirit so affected is instantly repelled away from the Paladin up to 20’, or until a solid object is met.
Verbal: Spirits of Evil I repel thee!

ability.repel-good.Name: Repel Good
ability.repel-good.Effect:
This power will work on any goodly creature with a spirit within 20’. A goodly spirit so affected is instantly repelled away from the Unholy Champion up to 20’, or until a solid object is met.
 Any Unholy Champion may sacrifice this ability in order to gain a permanent beneficial Curse (signed on card). This operates in the same manner as a Paladin’s Permanent Bless being irremovable as long as the Unholy Champion is an Unholy Champion. If the Unholy Champion becomes immune to Handbook Curses (as per the table 3 post 8th ability), then he remains cursed and retains the A/C benefit. If however he becomes immune to non-handbook curses (for example via the table 10 immunity), then they lose the A/C benefit from their curse.

ability.repel-undead.Name: Repel Undead
ability.repel-undead.Effect:
This power will work on any Undead creature with a spirit within 20’. An Undead so affected is instantly repelled away from the Paladin up to 20’, or until a solid object is met.
Verbal: Undead spirit I repel thee!

ability.resistance-to-own-element.Name: Resistance to own element
ability.resistance-to-own-element.Effect: This skill means that the Power-Master cannot be harmed by natural occurrences of his element, including lightning for air Power-Masters and rock-falls for earth. Additionally they take only half-effect from supernatural attacks of that element.

ability.shield-the-master.Name: Shield the Master
ability.shield-the-master.Effect: Should a Circle member lay a hand upon the shoulder of this Valdstayn, then all ranged magical spells and effects which target the Circle member, instead target this Valdstayn. While using this ability the Valdstayn gains 2 additional MAC. Note that it is possible for two Valdstayn to use this power on each other! In which case each takes attacks destined for the other, and both gain the additional magical AC.

ability.stand-by-the-master.Name: Stand by the Master
ability.stand-by-the-master.Effect: Negates one listed magical domination effect and grants immunity to that effect for the following five minutes. There must be another member of the Circle on the adventure for this to work.

ability.telekinesis.Name: Telekinesis
ability.telekinesis.Effect:
This spell will move one object as directed by the caster. The force of the telekinesis equals the force the referee can exert with one hand. It cannot be used to wield a weapon effectively. It cannot pick up objects that contain a spirit. Only one Telekinesis may be cast upon one object or by a wizard at any one time.
Verbal: Sylphs of air I conjure thee telekinesise that... to there

ability.tell-animal-type.Name: Tell Animal Type
ability.tell-animal-type.Effect: With 10 seconds examination can tell the type of natural animal something is. This does not give level or additional information.

ability.tell-direction.Name: Tell Direction
ability.tell-direction.Effect: With 10 seconds looking at an open sky the druid can tell which way is North.

ability.tell-disease.Name: Tell Disease
ability.tell-disease.Effect: With 10 seconds examination can tell if an object/liquid is diseased or if a Flesh & Blood (as above) creature has been diseased. User will receive approximate information as to the potency/quantity/duration of the disease.

ability.tell-plant-type.Name: Tell Plant Type
ability.tell-plant-type.Effect: Recognises natural plants. User can identify the plant’s type and receive some general information about that plant from the adventure’s referee. This ability has a range of Line of Sight.

ability.tell-poison.Name: Tell Poison
ability.tell-poison.Effect: With 10 seconds examination can tell if an object/liquid is poisonous or if a Flesh & Blood creature has been poisoned. User will receive approximate information as to the potency/quantity/duration of the poison. Has a 1” range.

ability.tell-time.Name: Tell Time
ability.tell-time.Effect: With 10 seconds looking at an open sky the druid can tell the time, to within the nearest ¼ hour.

ability.trusty-and-old-armour.Name: Trusty & Old (armour)
ability.trusty-and-old-armour.Effect: The Armour the character begins the adventure with is immune to Shatter, Rust, Melt, Disintegrate and Warp until the end of the adventure. If this armour is somehow destroyed or lost before the end of the adventure, the character gains no achievement points for that day.

ability.undead-returner.Name: Undead Returner
ability.undead-returner.Effect:
Unholy Champions upon their death may choose to release an evil spirit to seek vengeance upon their slayer. This standardly takes the form of an undead. The more potent the Unholy Champion the more potent the Undead Returner. For the statistics of these undead please refer to the Handbook or Word from Above publications. Their hits are now calculated as though the Unholy Champion had raised them and are thus dependent upon his level [this does included published increases such as Undead Master]. It is possible to choose an undead lower than your current level (e.g. a 6th level Unholy Champion could return as a Ghoul). An Unholy Champion’s returner will seek to kill their slayer, anyone involved in their death, and may then act as it wishes until slain.
1: Zombie
2: Zombie
3: Skeleton
4: Ghoul
5: Ghoul
6: Mummy
7: Wraith
8: Wight

ability.use-spirit-items.Name: Use Spirit Items
ability.use-spirit-items.Effect: This skill allows you to make full use of spiritual items of their alignment.

ability.weapon-mastery-with-h-or-mp.Name: Weapon mastery with H or MP weapon
ability.weapon-mastery-with-h-or-mp.Effect: By means of training and practice the Halfling may become more skilled with one specific weapon e.g. Dagger, Broadsword, Hand Mace, Battle Axe, Bastard Sword, Spear etc. This Mastery means that one extra grade of damage is added to the normal base damage done by a weapon of this type. Any thrown or machine propelled weapon may be chosen.

ability.1-dac-in-darkness.Name: 1 DAC in Darkness
ability.1-dac-in-darkness.Effect: While in darkness your DAC is increased by 1.

ability.half-effect-magic.Name: 1/2 effect magic
ability.half-effect-magic.Effect: You are naturally magic resistant, so they take only half effect from all magic, resisting spells as if they were twice their level. As a result of this, any wizard loses half their mana.

ability.half-effect-paralysis.Name: 1/2 effect paralysis
ability.half-effect-paralysis.Effect: Half effect from all forms of paralysis (so 5 minutes would be reduced to 2 minutes 30 seconds, for example).

ability.half-effect-poison.Name: 1/2 effect poison
ability.half-effect-poison.Effect: Half effect from all forms of poison

ability.1st-backstab.Name: 1st Backstab
ability.1st-backstab.Effect: The Backstab skill grants +1 damage grade to blows stuck from behind by the user. It may also be applied to H or MP attacks from behind. It may also be applied to blows struck versus completely helpless targets.

ability.1st-grade-of-strength.Name: 1st Grade of Strength
ability.1st-grade-of-strength.Effect: Each grade of Strength allows the character to inflict one additional grade of damage [still limited by maximum damage]. It also allows the possessor to be able to ‘carry’ a single normal person / load by placing both of their hands on the target. If two grades of strength are possessed it is possible to carry a person in a single handgrip, or two people with one in each hand. Strength being used to carry things cannot at the same time be used to increase the damage grade called.

ability.three-quarter-effect-paralysis.Name: 3/4 effect paralysis
ability.three-quarter-effect-paralysis.Effect: Take only 1/4 the effect of paralysis (so 5 minutes would be reduced to 1 minute 15 seconds, for example).

ability.three-quarter-effect-poison.Name: 3/4 effect poison
ability.three-quarter-effect-poison.Effect: Take only 1/4 of the effects of poisons.

ability.beguile.Name: Beguile
ability.beguile.Effect: The Beguile ability influences one target within 20' in a similar manner to the Beguile Spirit miracle. It affects any target with a resistance level of up to the user's own level, and is considered to be from a magical and spiritual source. The Beguile lasts 5 minutes, during which time the target must role-play as if the user is their closest and most trusted friend, despite any evidence to the contrary, and will generally do anything they can to aid the user. Their alignment is not changed, so that they may still find some acts repugnant, for example, and they are unlikely to be willing to commit suicidal acts, but will otherwise act to the best of their ability to do as the user wants.

ability.conceal-lie.Name: Conceal Lie
ability.conceal-lie.Effect: The Conceal Lies ability enables the Blauz to lie to any ability which detects lies. It lasts for 5 minutes, and is considered to be both magical and spiritual in power - if the target is affected by either of these they are influenced by the ability, even if the Lie Detection power they are using is neuronic, for example.

ability.consume-primal-vitae.Name: Consume Primal Vitae
ability.consume-primal-vitae.Effect: Requires 30 seconds physical contact with a helpless or willing, living, fully flesh-and-blood target. The touch draws the strength from the victim and gives it to the Duidoin, leaving the victim suffering the first, five-minute stage of Disease for 15 minutes (i.e. they are unable to run, shout, cast, use DAC or fight. They may still walk and talk). Immunity to Disease grants immunity to the effect, as does Immunity to Flesh-and-Blood effects, even the limited immunity possessed by elves. If the target is affected, the Duidoin is cured 3 total body and 1 to the most injured location for each resistance level possessed by the victim-this resistance level is taken to be the lowest of their resistance to magic and spirits. Temporary power-ups or resistances such as the gold Hearten spell do not increase the curing received. No target may suffer the effects of a Consume Primal Vitae more than twice in a 24-hour period.

ability.immunity-to-darkness.Name: Darkness
ability.immunity-to-darkness.Effect: Can now see through supernatural darkness in all ways. This does not mean they can see in real-world darkness

ability.discern-edible.Name: Discern Edible
ability.discern-edible.Effect: Ogres can naturally tell if something is edible. The discern has 10ft range and will reveal if something is edible or not. It will not reveal if something has been poisoned (for example a chunk of beef would be edible even if poisoned) but would reveal if something naturally can’t be eaten (e.g. a creature with acidic blood).

ability.double-dac-while-fleeing.Name: Double DAC while Fleeing
ability.double-dac-while-fleeing.Effect: While in full retreat, doing nothing but fleeing, the user doubles their DAC value to their maximum AC.

ability.draw-on-earthpower.Name: Draw on Earthpower
ability.draw-on-earthpower.Effect: By spending one minute in inactive concentration drawing upon the natural force around them for assistance - this allows the Alfar to mimic any one Earthpower Evocation which is on the standard list (As detailed in The Druids Way) of their own level or below, using the appropriate gestures but without verbals.

ability.earthshift.Name: Earthshift
ability.earthshift.Effect:
This spell transports the wizard from a spot immersed in the appropriate element to another similar point that the caster can see or is within 20'. There is a 2 second period of disorientation on arrival.
In general, there must be a source of the appropriate element at each end of a size approximately equal to half the caster's size.

ability.evaluate-metal-stone-jewels.Name: Evaluate (metal, stone, jewels only)
ability.evaluate-metal-stone-jewels.Effect: This skill allows you to judge the intrinsic value of an metal, stone, or jewel. It will not tell the you whether an item has any special properties (i.e. magic, spirit, etc); simply the fiscal value of the item in grulls.

ability.immunity-to-tracking.Name: Immunity to Tracking
ability.immunity-to-tracking.Effect: You no longer leave tracks or make sounds when moving in your natural environment (immunity to tracking and acute hearing)

ability.light-sensitivity.Name: Light Sensitivity
ability.light-sensitivity.Effect: Drowe hate daylight and suffer a -2 reduction to their armour class in it

ability.meld-with-stone.Name: Meld with Stone
ability.meld-with-stone.Effect:
This spell draws the wizard into the earth upon which he is standing and, for the duration of the spell, the wizard is deemed not to exist except for any purpose bar observation. The wizard may perceive during this time but cannot prematurely end the spell, nor take any other actions. A Dispel Magic of the appropriate level from an external source will end the spell and eject the wizard from the earth, however, as the ground where the wizard vanished radiates magic. Whilst under the effects of this spell, no time passes for the caster; as such, any effects they were under when they enter the ground pause until they are released from it. This applies to both beneficial and disadvantageous effects.
Verbal: Gnomes of earth take me in your embrace and hide me from sight.

ability.neuromastery-innate.Name: Neuromastery
ability.neuromastery-innate.Effect:
Choose one of the below on use -
 # Neuro Mastery...
On Darkness: As long as the light is at most weak candlelight, the user may ‘fly’.
Through Darkness: Half effect from darkness-based attacks.
On Air: The user may ‘fly’.
Through Air: Half effect from air attacks, including electrical.
On Water: The caster may walk on water as if it were solid ground.
Through Water: The caster may breathe underwater.
Note: Either version of Neuro-Mastery Water grants the user ½ effect potions, poisons, and acid for the duration.
On Light: The user may ‘fly’, as long as the light is at least strong candlelight.
Through Light: Half effect from light-based attacks.
On Earth: The user may walk on walls, floors, ceilings, mud, quicksand, as if it were solid, level ground.
Through Earth: The user may walk through any stone or earth wall of not more than 10’ in thickness. Walls thicker than this cannot be entered.
Through Fire: Half effect fire-based attacks.
The Neuro Mastery Through abilities above will stack with resistances to such attacks acquired post-8th, though they will not stack with other temporary defences (e.g. Walk through Fire Spell, or the Resist Fire
evocation).
Only one Neuro-Mastery may be active at a time.

ability.passwall.Name: Passwall
ability.passwall.Effect:
This spell allows the caster to walk through any wall or stone object of not more than 10' in thickness. If the wall is more than 10' thick the spell fails to work but mana and life points are still expended. It does not apply to floors and the user can only walk in a straight line. You cannot cast multiple Passwall spells to allow more movement.
 Verbal: Gnomes of earth I conjure thee, grant me the power to passwall

ability.recognise-ep.Name: Recognise EP
ability.recognise-ep.Effect: This discern has a 1” range and will reveal whether something within that range has Earthpower or not. Yes/No answer

ability.regeneration.Name: Regeneration
ability.regeneration.Effect: You constantly and slowly regenerate. You gets one total body life point and one to the most injured location back every five minutes of ’time in’. It cannot regenerate fire or spiritual damage however and neither can it regenerate once it is dead. Limbs will also regenerate if severed, after 12 hours.

ability.terror-scream.Name: Terror Scream
ability.terror-scream.Effect: The Terror Scream causes fear in all creatures of the Blauz's level or below for one minute. This effect is “physical” and does not affect mindless creatures, such as zombies or elementals. It will however affect non-physical creatures capable of hearing the sound, as long as they are not mindless. This scream does not affect other Blauz.

ability.the-touch.Name: The Touch
ability.the-touch.Effect: Calabrim possess an ability they call 'The Touch' and it is this ability which paralyses a magic using creature. If the target possesses mana points, or magical innate powers it functions as a paralysis lasting 5 minutes. However the cost of using this ability is steep, the Calabrim is drained one level, which is recovered in the same fashion as a level lost to the touch of a wraith. However as it is a self-inflicted level loss immunity to level drain does not apply. If the ability fails in any fashion (e.g. the target is immune to paralysis, has no magical ability or uses a war cry to keep moving) no level is lost. In any event the touch cannot be used more than once for every two levels possessed in any given day regardless of success or failure.

ability.true-kin-with-reed.Name: True Kin With Reed
ability.true-kin-with-reed.Effect:
Members of the reed may:
• Use touch range discerns on each other up to line of sight
• all know of each other’s approximate location
• All know if others are alive or dead
• They may send messages (as below) between each other at the cost of 3 tblp per use
 Improved Message: One target known to the user or in sight of them receives a telepathic message of up to one sentence in length (at most 20 words, all one sentence only). This message will span any distance, even interplanar distances.

ability.vulnerability-to-cold.Name: Vulnerability to cold
ability.vulnerability-to-cold.Effect: Crol cannot acquire any form of immunity to cold and lose 4 DAC and 1 grade of strength (to a minimum of 0) in severe cold environments

ability.ward-pact-atwill.Name: Ward pact
ability.ward-pact-atwill.Effect:
An Ancient Folk gains certain ‘pacts’ with other-worldly creatures as they gain levels. These pacts are gained at second, fourth, six and eighth level. They are gained at no cost, and once a player has chosen a level’s pact it may never be changed.
For a pact to work against a specific creature the Ancient Folk must announce their pact clearly within hearing of that creature. They must loudly state their name, ancestry, and what they have a pact with.
If an Ancient Folk betrays a pact, by announcing it and then attacking that creature (except in purest self-defence), that pact is lost forever. The exact effect of a ward pact depends on the relative levels of the Ancient Folk and the creature. Pacts only fully affect creatures of the same or lower level than the user.
Creatures fully affected by an Ancient Folk’s ward pact may not choose to attack the Ancient Folk, except in purest self-defence. They may be forced to do so if controlled by another, such as a controlled undead or elemental, but will be reluctant and attempt to choose other targets where possible. In the situation where an affected creature strikes the Ancient Folk by mistake, it should be considered that at the last minute the creature realised the nature of his target, due to supernatural forces, and pulled back so inflicting no damage.
Creatures of too high a level to be fully affected by a pact will still be aware of the nature of the pact, and will generally act in a friendlier manner towards the Ancient Folk - the exact actions taken dependent on the creature in question. This is only a ‘role-play’ effect, but should usually make a noticeable difference in attitude.
The ward pacts standardly available to Ancient Folk are listed below. It is possible for individuals to seek to forge other pacts, though these are individual and handled with points requests. The exception to this is the Pact with Glass as detailed in the post 8th tables later on. 

• Undead- This works on all forms of undead. 
• Elemental - There are six different pacts, Salamanders, Shades, Sprites, Sylphs, Gnomes, and Undines. Each pact only affects elementals of that element. 
• Supernatural Power - The Ancient Folk may select a specific deity. The pact works against supernatural minions of that deity. If a pact is taken with a Magical Dragon or Drake this does not grant a pact with elves or elementals of that colour. For example, a pact with the Lady of the Stars would not influence priests of the Lady of the Stars, but would affect her angels.
• Elvenkind - May be any one of fire, air, earth, water, light, dark, drowe, winter, twilight or wood elves. 
• Faeries may not be pacted, nor may Seasonal, Onyx or Jade Elves
